subject: planner, statistics: use the correct column ID when recording stats loading status (#52208)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent. The change correctly fixes UsedStatsInfo recording by mapping plan-time `expression.Column.UniqueID` back to metadata column ID via `HistColl.UniqueID2colInfoID` before writing `StmtCtx` load-status maps (which are rendered via `TableInfo.FindColumnNameByID`). The HistColl index/column maps are also renamed to reflect they store column UniqueIDs, and a planstats case is added to assert `EXPLAIN` prints `stats:partial[...]` with the right column/index names. No Blocker/High issues found in planner/statistics correctness, session/runtime behavior, or concurrency/data-consistency.
